name: 6-Separating Surface Voxelization
definition: A surface voxelization technique that produces a voxel set that is thinner than conservative voxelization but remains connected and gap-free. It is derived by adapting the triangle/box overlap test.
summary: 6-Separating Surface Voxelization is a gap-free, 26-connected surface voxelization method that produces a thinner voxel set than conservative voxelization while remaining 6-separating.
